components.remaining: (1) A proof that GCH can be eliminated from the Horn preservation theorem (Keisler 1965 [5]; Galvin 1970 [3]; Mansfield preprint [14]) is not supplied: Shelah p. 225 gives no proof and none of those works is held; the statement is reported. (2) GCH-free versions of Keisler's Theorems 2.5, 2.8, 2.13, 2.14 and Corollaries 2.9, 2.10 are not proved (they rest on Theorem 2.5, an ultraproduct form not covered by Shelah part 1); Theorems 2.4 (w03a-p03-018), 2.6, 2.7, 2.11 and 2.12 are proved GCH-free. (3) Decomposition stages 1-2 (lambda^+-good ultrafilters exist under lambda^+=2^lambda; they give lambda^+-saturated ultrapowers) are reported from Shelah p. 224 only: Keisler 1964 [7], [8] are not held and good is not defined on Shelah's pages; stage 3 and the composition are proved. (4) The results of Kochen, Mansfield, Kunen, Silver and Rucker are reported, not proved (works not held). (5) Shelah part 3 and the goodness remark (p. 230) remain unproved in the source (block 1 boundary).
